entity.summary: Dutch bitcoin-only centralized trading platform offering current buy, sell, custody, transfer, target-order, recurring-purchase, and OTC services under the Bitonic brand.
entity.notes: Bitonic B.V. operates the current MiCAR-authorized platform. BL3P closed in December 2024 and transferred remaining balances to Bitonic, so HEI records BL3P as the direct predecessor and repairs the reciprocal successor link. Bitonic's company history gives a 2012 founding date, but launch_date remains null here because the entity's current exchange-service surface evolved across instant purchase, BL3P, custody, and account products.

evidence.title: Bitonic User Agreement
evidence.notes: Current agreement identifies Bitonic B.V., its Dutch registration, MiCAR authorization, account services, and regulated buy-and-sell activity.

evidence.title: Bitonic legal documents and June 2026 volume report
evidence.notes: Current first-party legal page reports June 2026 bitcoin and euro trading volume and exposes active order-execution, custody, pricing, and compliance documents.
